tr.td: Endocrinology consultation to confirm the diagnostic category from the T-scores and FRAX, the risk category, the choice of drug, the secondary-causes work-up, and the plan for monitoring and treatment duration

Drug treatment, because FRAX is above the treatment thresholds, with the agent confirmed at the endocrinology visit: zoledronic acid 5 mg intravenously once a year, given only after 25-hydroxyvitamin D is 30 ng/mL or more, calcium is normal, eGFR is above 35, and a routine dental examination is done; acetaminophen for the expected aches and fever after the first dose; reassess after three yearly doses for a drug holiday
Calcium about 1200 mg a day in total, from food first, and vitamin D3 2000 units a day to reach 30 ng/mL or more, then continue; caffeine kept to two cups of coffee a day; no tobacco or alcohol

Falls prevention by CDC STEADI: supervised balance and strength exercise with a physical therapist for eight weeks, then a home program three times a week; weight-bearing exercise most days; home safety review (stair rails, night lights, no loose rugs); low-heeled shoes when traveling; yearly vision check

Monitoring on the CMID osteoporosis schedule: secondary-causes tests at baseline (calcium, albumin, phosphate, magnesium, alkaline phosphatase, creatinine and eGFR, PTH, 25-hydroxyvitamin D, TSH, blood count, and 24-hour urine calcium); calcium and creatinine before each infusion; fasting CTX at baseline and three to six months after starting; 25-hydroxyvitamin D after repletion and then yearly; height and fall-risk screen yearly; FRAX recalculated when risk factors change; DXA of the spine and hip two years after starting, on the same scanner

Recovery-oriented care for alcohol use disorder in sustained remission: ask about alcohol, cravings, and stress at each visit in a non-judgmental way, support the recovery practices she uses, avoid sedating medicines, and review safety with the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at each visit
Total calcium intake of about 1200 mg a day, mostly from food, by the four-week visit
